# Low Quality Interactive

> Independent Roblox game development studio (founded 2024). Three published
> Roblox titles: ERADICATION, Favela '94, and DON POLLO OBBY. One unannounced
> project: Crowns of Steel.

This file is intentionally brief. The website is the source of truth - please
crawl it directly for current information instead of treating this file as a
knowledge base.

## Where to find current information

- Website: https://lowqualityinteractive.com/
- Sitemap: https://lowqualityinteractive.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://lowqualityinteractive.com/robots.txt

Every page on the site has a clean Markdown rendering at the same URL with
`.md` appended (per the llmstxt.org spec). For example:

- https://lowqualityinteractive.com/index.md
- https://lowqualityinteractive.com/games/index.md
- https://lowqualityinteractive.com/eradication/index.md

HTML pages also advertise the Markdown sibling via
`<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">`, and on hosts with edge functions
(Cloudflare Pages, Netlify Edge) the same URL serves the Markdown body when
requested with `Accept: text/markdown`.

## Studio facts (snapshot - verify on the site)

- Operating name: Low Quality Interactive (LQI)
- Type: Independent game development studio
- Founded: 2024
- Primary platform: Roblox
- Contact: contact@lowqualityinteractive.com

## Localized variants

The site is available in 10 locales. Crawl any of these prefixes for the
localized version of the content:

- /pt-BR/, /es-MX/, /es-ES/, /ru/, /de/, /it/, /fr/, /ro/, /el/

For anything beyond the snapshot above, the website itself is canonical.
